description: This file contains functions for parsing Chinese hanzi-pinyin pairs, answer strings, and fill-in-the-blank paragraph structures with support for ruby annotations and blank tokens, used in a language learning or testing application.

methods.name: parseHanziPinyinPairs
methods.description: Parses all hanzi-pinyin pairs from a given text string.

methods.name: parseAnswer
methods.description: Parses a text to extract a single hanzi-pinyin pair if present, otherwise returns the original text.

methods.name: parseBlanks
methods.description: Parses a paragraph of HTML-like text containing <ruby> elements and BLANK tokens into structured paragraph elements with blanks.
